springtime.name: The Springtime of Nations
springtime.text: {name}. Revolution sweeps the continent; unrest soars everywhere.

famine.name: The Great Famine
famine.text: {name} devastates {province}: {pop|inv|frac} of its people die or emigrate.
famine.effect: Happens once: {province|place} loses {pop|inv|pct} of its people and gains {unrest} unrest.

cholera.name: Cholera
cholera.effect: Strikes {nations|word} nations at random; every province of each loses {pop|inv|pct} of its people and gains {unrest} unrest.

panic.name: The Panic
panic.text: {name}. Banks fail across Europe: every nation loses {gold|inv|frac} its gold and earns {earns|inv|frac} less for {seasons|years}.
panic.effect: Happens once, and also adds {unrest} unrest in every province.

compromise.name: The Compromise
compromise.text: {name}: {nation} becomes a dual monarchy, and {province|place} is calmed.
compromise.effect: Happens once, while {nation|nation} holds {province|place} and its unrest there is above {unrest}: {nation|nation} accepts the {people|people} people and becomes {newName} ({newAdj}), and {province|place} falls to {calm} unrest.

serfdom.name: Emancipation of the serfs
serfdom.text: {nation} frees the serfs; workers pour into the factories of {provinces|place}.
serfdom.effect: Until it happens, {nation|nation}'s factories run at {before|frac} speed. It happens once, and {provinces|place} gain {factories|word} factor{factories|ies} each if {nation|nation} still holds them.

incident.name: Border incident
incident.text: A border incident sours relations between {a} and {b}.
incident.effect: Sours relations between a nation and its biggest threat.

marriage.name: Royal marriage
marriage.effect: Warms relations between two nations, unless one is the other's biggest threat.

harvest.name: Failed harvest
harvest.text: A failed harvest brings bread riots to {nation}.
harvest.effect: Adds {unrest} unrest in every province of one nation, chosen at random.

shevchenko.name: Ukrainian national awakening
shevchenko.text: Shevchenko's poems spark a {name}; unrest grows in {people|people} lands.
shevchenko.effect: Happens once: wherever another people rules them, the {people|people} people want {awake} more unrest for good, and their uprisings grow larger.

awakening.name: National awakening
awakening.text: A national awakening stirs the {people|people} people; their provinces grow restless.
awakening.effect: Stirs one of the peoples below at random, if it has not awakened yet and another people rules some of its land: wherever others rule it, it wants {awake} more unrest for good, and its uprisings grow larger.

revolution.name: Military revolution
revolution.text: {name}. {era}: every war forecast in Europe shifts.
revolution.effect: Replaces the way of war with another one, drawn at random from the rest.

boom.name: Boom
boom.text: {find} in {province} ({nation}): {factories|word} factories' worth of industry overnight.
boom.effect: One random province that isn't occupied gains {factories|word} factories and {pop|up} more people.

ultimatum.name: Ultimatum
ultimatum.rattleText: {a} rattles its sabre at {b} over {pretext}, then thinks better of it.
ultimatum.text: Crisis. {a} sends {b} an ultimatum. {b} backs down, humiliated, and pays {gold} gold.
ultimatum.effect: A nation sends one to its biggest threat next door when a war for one of its provinces looks nearly worth fighting (within {margin} gold of paying off); otherwise it only rattles its sabre, {rattle|pct} of the time. The rival backs down if it believes its chance of winning is below {backDown|pct}: it pays {pay|pct} of its gold and gains {unrest} unrest everywhere. Otherwise the war begins.
ultimatum.warText: Crisis. {a} sends {b} an ultimatum over {province}. {b} refuses, and the {war} begins.

greatWar.name: Great War
greatWar.text: The lamps go out all over Europe. A shot in the Balkans sets the alliances in motion: {a} and {b} go to war. The {name} begins.
greatWar.effect: The two great powers on the worst terms go to war in the {rules.greatWar.season|season} of {rules.greatWar.year}; every running war is abandoned, and every nation allied to either side joins it.

armistice.name: The Armistice
armistice.text: {name}. At the eleventh hour the guns fall silent; peace is made on the lines as they stand.
armistice.effect: Every war still running ends on the lines as they stand: each occupier keeps what it holds.

opening.name: The age begins
opening.text: Europe, {rules.start}. {count|Word} nations, each with its own ambition for the day the guns of the coming great war fall silent: to be the richest great power, to unite its people, or just to survive.
